claim.en: Ján Mižík was elected to the Lastomír council in 2022 for SMER-SD with 222 votes; he has been a councillor since 2018, working in agriculture.
claim.sk: Ján Mižík bol zvolený do OZ Lastomír v roku 2022 za SMER-SD s 222 hlasmi; poslancom je od roku 2018, oblasť pôsobenia poľnohospodárstvo.
